en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a busy, narrow, sloping street lined with multi‑story buildings and shops. People in early 20th‑century dress walk up and down the steep street. At the bottom left is a corner building with an awning and a sign on the wall. A domed structure rises in the background. The caption at the bottom reads 'CONSTANTINOPLE. Kûksek Kaldirim.' and there is a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' over the image.
